recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized, painterly illustration of a smiling man in sunglasses riding a vintage motorcycle, set against a solid cream background with bold, multi-layered typographic headers in red, teal, and black.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with a slight diagonal lean to imply motion
High-contrast primary colors against a neutral off-white field
Bold, heavy typography framing the top of the central figure
Painterly textures on the motorcycle chrome and leather contrasting with flat background
coreInvariants: Limited color palette (Red, Teal, Black, Cream)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure on a motorcycle, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The motorcycle's large front wheel and headlight provide a heavy base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large red header, moves down the figure's face, follows the motorcycle's diagonal line to the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper corners and around the edges to focus on the central character.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for text and key clothing items; muted, earthy tones for the motorcycle and skin.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display type features thick, blocky serifs and uniform stroke weight
Secondary type is highly condensed with tight tracking
Tertiary type is small, all-caps sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Asterisk used as a decorative separator in the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif paired with ultra-condensed sans-serif for a mid-century editorial look.
graphicDevices: Minimalist logo icon in the upper right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif display style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a gouache-style illustration of a cool man with sunglasses and a leather jacket riding a vintage motorcycle with a large windshield. The style should be 1960s commercial art with visible brushstrokes and a limited palette of teal, red, and brown on a solid cream background. Leave the top third of the image empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold slab-serif title in red at the top. Below it to the right, add a condensed sans-serif subtitle in teal. Add smaller black condensed text on the left side, ensuring all text is uppercase and follows a mid-century grid.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid cream color?
Does the illustration have a painterly, non-digital texture?
Is the main title a heavy slab-serif?
Are the primary colors limited to red and teal accents?

adjustableVariables: Specific accent colors (e.g., swapping teal for orange)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the character
postGenerationChecks: Check for visible brushstroke textures in the illustration
Ensure text is perfectly horizontal and not warped
Verify the cream background is consistent and free of artifacts
Confirm the slab-serif font has the appropriate visual weight
recipe.reuseFormula: Mid-century gouache illustration + Heavy Slab Serif Header + Condensed Sans-Serif Subheader + Limited Primary Palette + Cream Background
